allow_instructions: Always allow git push and git push --force-with-lease when the push target is not a deployment branch or a stage branch.
Treat ordinary feature and chore work branches as safe to push and force-push-with-lease without asking.
Always allow creating and editing files under .agents/skills/** (e.g. SKILL.md and that skill's scripts/, references/, and assets/).
block_instructions: Never auto-allow git push or force-push-with-lease when the target is a deployment branch. Examples only (not exhaustive): main, master, develop, trunk, release-*, v*. Require approval instead.
Never auto-allow git push or force-push-with-lease when the target is a stage branch. Examples only (not exhaustive): stage/*, stage-*. Require approval instead.
Never auto-allow git push --force or git push -f unless --force-with-lease is also present.
